rule: Thread decision/replay event is current authority where explicitly listed
Accepted planning band; future realization remains replay-dependent
Accepted accounting/sustainment value until dedicated closeout refines it
Future condition/decision; not a completed event
Factory/arsenal accepted; does not imply service release
Eligible for normal unit use; does not imply theater assignment
Allocated to a unit/theater; does not imply ready
Actually present in the replayed combat event
End-to-end system effect unless explicitly component-scoped; do not stack correlated percentages
Absorb into current unit state after each phase; do not reapply as future multiplier
